title: Instrumentation and OpenTelemetry
summary: Record useful traces and errors across server-side requests.

subtopics.title: Follow work with a trace
subtopics.explanation: A trace groups the work caused by one request, even when that work crosses services. A trace ID lets operators connect the browser request to server operations and downstream calls. Use traces to answer where a slow or failed request spent its time.

subtopics.title: Record operations with spans
subtopics.explanation: A span records one operation inside a trace, such as rendering a route or calling an API. It can include timing, status, and carefully chosen attributes. Parent and child spans show how work is nested, but avoid attaching secrets or personal data.

subtopics.title: Measure behavior with metrics
subtopics.explanation: Metrics summarize values over time, such as request duration, error count, or traffic volume. A dashboard can show whether a deployment changed the trend. Choose a small set tied to user impact, and avoid labels with unbounded values such as full URLs or user IDs.

subtopics.title: Use logs for event details
subtopics.explanation: Logs record what happened at a particular point, such as a failed data request. Include a trace or request identifier so operators can find the related spans. Keep log fields structured and useful; raw request bodies can expose private information.

subtopics.title: Protect telemetry data
subtopics.explanation: Remove credentials, tokens, and personal values before sending telemetry to an observability service. Sampling can reduce cost by recording only some successful traces while retaining failures. Confirm that the sampling rule still preserves enough data to understand real user problems.

foundations.overview: Instrumentation is code that observes an application while it runs. OpenTelemetry provides shared formats for traces, metrics, and logs. In Next.js, server instrumentation can connect a request to downstream work, but exported data should avoid secrets and personal details.
foundations.mentalModel: A parcel tracking number links every handoff along the delivery route.
foundations.whyItMatters: It helps teams locate slow or failing requests in production.

keyTakeaways: A trace follows one request across services.
A span records one operation inside a trace.
Logs provide event details for diagnosis.
Redact sensitive data and control sampling.
